text_blocks.snippet: Heart block, also known as atrioventricular (AV) block, is a condition where the electrical signals that control heartbeats are partially or completely blocked. There are three degrees of heart block: first, second, and third, each with varying degrees of severity. First-degree AV block is the mildest form, while third-degree is the most severe and can be a medical emergency.
